pages.title: Engineered Enzyme
pages.text: A protein designed rather than evolved, folded around a pocket shaped for exactly one reaction. It speeds that reaction a millionfold and ignores everything else. It looks like a pale, slightly sticky crystal.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Natural enzymes are evolved to fit their substrates. I started from a genome, used a chiral crystal to fix the handedness and a zeolite to shape the pocket, then let the Bioreactor optimise the rest in nutrient broth.
